title: Integer multiplicity currents differing by a current supported in W₀ have equal measures outside W₀ (additive form)
statement: Let P, j ∈ ℕ, let S₁, S₂ ∈ 𝒟_j(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ j) have integer multiplicity representations R₁, R₂ (IMRep univ j, R_i.Represents S_i), and let W₀ ⊆ B ⊆ ℝ^P be open sets with spt(S₁ − S₂) ⊆ W₀, where S₁ − S₂ is the contract difference ((S₁ − S₂)(ω) = S₁(ω) − S₂(ω)). Then R₁.measure(B) + R₂.measure(W₀) = R₂.measure(B) + R₁.measure(W₀) in [0, ∞].
lean_statement: ∀ (P j : ℕ) (S₁ S₂ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) j) (R₁ R₂ : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) j) (W₀ B : Set (Euclid P)), R₁.Represents S₁ → R₂.Represents S₂ → IsOpen W₀ → IsOpen B → (S₁ - S₂).support ⊆ W₀ → W₀ ⊆ B → R₁.measure B + R₂.measure W₀ = R₂.measure B + R₁.measure W₀
